课程简介（中文）

《大学数学I》是面向非数学专业学生所开设的一门重要公共数学基础课程，系统讲授微积分学的核心内容。主要涵盖极限理论与级数基础、一元函数微积分学基础和多元函数微积分学入门，并对常微分方程做初步介绍。通过本课程的学习，学生将初步构建微积分知识体系，逐步培养严谨的数学思维，提升运用微积分工具解决实际问题的基本能力，为后续专业课程的学习提供必要的数学支撑。

课程简介（英文）

Comprehensive University Mathematics I is an important basic public mathematics course offered to non-mathematics majors, which systematically imparts the core content of calculus. It mainly covers the limit theory and fundamentals of series, the basics of single-variable calculus, and an introduction to multi-variable calculus, with a preliminary introduction to ordinary differential equations. Through the study of this course, students will initially construct a knowledge system of calculus, gradually develop rigorous mathematical thinking, and improve the basic ability to use calculus tools to solve practical problems, thus laying a necessary mathematical foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses.

教学目标

通过介绍微积分学的发展脉络与核心思想，培养学生探索创新的科学精神与严谨求实的治学态度，理解数学作为基础科学对国家科技自立自强的重要性；通过传授微积分学的基本理论、计算方法和重要应用，帮助学生构建系统的知识框架，训练抽象思维、逻辑推理、科学计算的能力，提升运用数学模型分析和解决实际问题的综合能力，为后续专业课程的学习奠定必要的数学基础。

教学方式

采用板书或者PPT，通过讲授，进行教学。

教学内容与进度安排

Week 1: Definition of sequences, recurrence relations, differences

 

Week 2: Definition of limits of sequences, infinitesimals and infinities

 

Week 3: Properties of limits and limit laws

 

Week 4: Concept of series, geometric series

 

Week 5: Definition of limits of functions, calculation of limits

 

Week 6: Continuity of functions; definition of derivatives

 

Week 7: Differentiation rules, higher-order derivatives, implicit differentiation

 

Week 8: Differentials, partial derivatives, total differentials

 

Week 9: Mean value theorems, L'Hôpital's rule

 

Week 10: Monotonicity test for functions, extrema and optimization

 

Week 11: Concavity, inflection points and asymptotes of curves; Taylor's formula

 

Week 12: Concept and properties of indefinite integrals, computation of indefinite integrals

 

Week 13: Concept and properties of definite integrals, fundamental theorem of calculus

 

Week 14: Computation of definite integrals, improper integrals

 

Week 15: Double integrals

 

Week 16: Basic concepts of differential equations, first-order differential equations

 

Weeks 17–18: Review sessions, examinations, grading, score recording
